visual_review: SQUARE: tall banded egg (tapered top) behind a round egg lying in front (back outline ends on front-egg knots, occlude), decorative band across the back egg, four short shine rays above. Hermite cubics with axis-aligned tangents at extremes for an exact fit.
omissions: Second (wavy) band on the back egg and one far-left ray dropped for 8-unit spacing.
